text:
Lokeswari 
+1(469) 351-0057 | lokeswari1295@gmail.com
Summary
Lead Data Scientist / AI-ML Engineer with over 8 years of experience delivering AI/ML space and advanced analytics solutions across healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and industrial sectors.
My expertise includes designing and deploying end-to-end AI architectures, implementing time-series forecasting, customer analytics, anomaly detection, graph-based modeling, and LLM-powered workflows to solve complex business challenges.
Experienced in architecting enterprise chatbot AI agents and NLP-driven conversational systems using LangChain, LangGraph, FastMCP, and advanced prompt engineering techniques.
Skilled in developing microservices with FastAPI and deploying scalable LLM applications using Docker and Kubernetes in hybrid environments.
I have successfully integrated retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and autonomous agents with LLMs to automate decision-making, enhance information retrieval, and reduce reliance on manual processes.
I am proficient in deploying large-scale ML and LLM systems on both AWS and Azure, using tools such as SageMaker, Glue, Lambda, ECS, Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure Kubernetes Service for scalable, production-grade solutions.
My work includes building robust data pipelines, advanced feature engineering, and embedding regulatory compliance frameworks such as HIPAA into AI and LLM model workflows.
I have partnered with cross-functional teams to align LLM and ML solutions with business goals, resulting in measurable gains in operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and decision-making speed.
I am skilled in containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and implementing observability frameworks for monitoring LLM and ML model performance, drift, and compliance adherence.
My technical stack spans Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS, and enterprise-grade LLMs including OpenAI GPT models.
I have delivered measurable business results, including a 15% improvement in forecast accuracy, a 10% increase in customer retention, and significant reductions in downtime and investigation time through AI and LLM-driven automation.
Recognized as a results-driven professional, I combine deep technical expertise in ML, LLMs, and data engineering with strong business acumen to deliver innovative, scalable, and high-impact AI 
solutions.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming & Scripting
Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript, Java, C++, Scala, R
Libraries: NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly
Version Control & DevOps: Git/GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes
AI & ML Frameworks
Machine Learning: scikit‑learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Keras, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Prophet/ARIMA
Deep Learning & LLMs: Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, NER, SpaCy, OpenAI (GPT‑4o, GPT‑4), LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI, Prompt engineering, FastMCP, Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Agentic & RAG Architectures: LangChain Agents, tool chaining, vector stores (FAISS, Pinecone, OpenSearch, ChromaDB), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering
Model Monitoring: OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, SageMaker Model Monitor, Observability, Logging, Distributed Tracing

Data Engineering & Cloud
Big Data & Streaming: PySpark, Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Apache Airflow
Databases: Snowflake, Redshift, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, vector databases
Cloud Platforms: AWS (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, Bedrock, ECS, EMR, CloudWatch), Azure (Databricks, ADF, HDInsight,AKS), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Composer)

Visualization & Reporting
Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, Grafana, Streamlit

EXPERIENCE
CVS HEALTH – Lead AI/ML Engineer | Healthcare | Richardson,TX (Remote) | Nov 2025 – present
Spearheaded the design and development of an end-to-end AI/ML-powered test automation platform for pharmacy benefit claims, orchestrating a 4-module microservices pipeline using Apache Kafka, significantly reducing manual test scenario creation effort.
Architected and implemented Generative AI capabilities using Google Vertex AI (Gemini) for automated test scenario generation, including prompt engineering, model caching, and KMS-secured API integration on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Developed a semantic validation engine leveraging Vertex AI text embeddings to evaluate and score AI-generated test scenarios against reference test beds, ensuring output accuracy and business rule compliance.
Designed and maintained a Python-based rule engine to automate scenario tagging and base scenario identification from complex BPS Excel data, translating intricate PBM business logic into scalable, maintainable code.
Built robust ETL/data processing pipelines using pandas and NumPy for multi-sheet Excel ingestion, cross-sheet enrichment, formulary logic processing, and combinatorial test scenario replication.
Engineered event-driven microservices using Kafka consumer/producer patterns and FastAPI health endpoints, deployed as stateless Docker containers across multiple environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Managed cloud-native infrastructure including GCS for file storage, PostgreSQL and MongoDB for persistence and caching, and GCP Secret Manager for secure credential management across all service modules.
Established and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions with reusable workflows, automated unit testing with coverage reporting, SAST/DAST security scanning, and container image publishing to JFrog Artifactory.
Implemented observability and monitoring using OpenTelemetry instrumentation with OTLP exporters, enabling distributed tracing and logging across all Kafka-based microservices.
Created and maintained environment specific YAML configuration frameworks supporting seamless deployment across 7+ environments, including Confluent Cloud Kafka clusters, GCS buckets, and Vertex AI project settings.
Led the development of comprehensive test suites using pytest and integration tests, covering processors, rule engines, Kafka integration, GCS operations, and database interactions to ensure pipeline reliability.
Drove data contract design by defining and enforcing JSON message schemas across modules, ensuring consistent inter-service communication and backward compatibility within the Kafka event-driven pipeline.
Owned the GenAI feedback loop mechanism integrating MongoDB-backed feedback collections and business knowledge stores to continuously improve AI-generated scenario quality based on SME inputs.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders including PBM business analysts and QA teams to translate complex benefit testing requirements into automated ML/engineering solutions, accelerating testing cycles.
Provided technical leadership through code reviews, architectural decision-making, and mentoring engineers on Python best practices, cloud-native design patterns, and Generative AI integration strategies.

FEPOC – Senior Data Scientist | Healthcare | Reston,VA (Remote) | Jun 2024 – Nov 2025
Designed and deployed production-grade AI solutions by architecting ingestion with AWS Glue, secure storage in S3 and Snowflake, model training in SageMaker, and serverless deployment through Lambda and ECS. Implemented CloudWatch dashboards to monitor latency, throughput, and model health in real time.
Developed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chatbots and autonomous query agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and FastMCP to serve member services and provider analytics. These agents automated natural language query resolution, significantly reducing dependency on manual analyst intervention.
Designed and executed LLM evaluation frameworks to test agent response accuracy, output consistency, and identify potential bias using both synthetic and real-world queries.
Applied advanced prompt engineering techniques to enhance the accuracy, relevance, and contextual memory of natural language queries on sales and performance data.  
Designed FastAPI-based microservices to expose chatbot agent endpoints, enabling seamless integration with frontend and analytics platforms.
Created LLM-powered claims analytics workflows combining RAG, SQL chaining, and domain memory. Delivered context-aware recommendations that merged structured SQL results with unstructured knowledge retrieval.
Incorporated HIPAA-compliant data handling measures into AI pipelines, including data masking, field-level encryption, and controlled access policies. Maintained full audit trails in Snowflake and AWS for compliance verification.
Designed scalable, event-driven AI deployments leveraging AWS Lambda for lightweight inference and ECS for containerized workloads. Implemented blue-green deployment strategies with automated rollback mechanisms.
Integrated generative AI components into legacy healthcare analytics systems using modular APIs. This ensured interoperability with existing tools while allowing for quick upgrades or model swaps.
Built deep learning NLP pipelines for unstructured medical text using BERT-based encoders and CNN architectures to perform named entity recognition (NER), clinical text summarization, and semantic enrichment of provider insights.
Collaborated with engineering teams to deploy containerized LLM agents using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring high performance and fault-tolerant chatbot experiences.
Fine-tuned and evaluated large language models (LLMs) including GPT-4 and Llama-3 variants to improve domain-specific understanding for healthcare claims analytics and provider services. Applied parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and LoRA adapters to achieve measurable gains in accuracy and response consistency while optimizing cost.
Configured observability frameworks using AWS CloudWatch, SageMaker Model Monitor, and custom logging. Established automated anomaly detection alerts to notify stakeholders of potential system issues.
Collaborated with engineering teams to containerize AI models with Docker and deploy them in ECS clusters. Optimized container startup times and resource allocation for high-volume workloads.
Partnered with compliance and security teams to implement robust role-based access control (RBAC) and secure API gateways. This ensured that data was accessed only by authorized systems and personnel.
Worked closely with product managers to design AI features that directly addressed member experience gaps. Led demos and workshops to gather feedback and refine solution design.
Optimized vector search performance in Pinecone for low-latency retrieval at scale. Tuned index parameters to balance accuracy and speed for chatbot and analytics workflows.
Developed automated data quality validation scripts in Python using Pandas and NumPy. These scripts ensured clean, standardized datasets before ingestion into AI pipelines.
Maintained a Git-based version control workflow with feature branching, code reviews, and CI/CD integration. This improved collaboration and reduced deployment errors.

Verizon – Data scientist III | Telecom | Dallas, TX(Remote) | Jan 2023 – Apr 2024
Led the design and implementation of a customer intelligence platform that leveraged machine learning, deep learning and LLMs to improve churn prediction, retention targeting, and user experience personalization across Verizon's digital channels.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams across data engineering, CRM, marketing, and product to identify business requirements and define the data and model architecture for the solution.
Built ML models using Vertex AI to predict customer churn and next-best-action recommendations based on behavioral data, billing history, and customer interaction logs.
Developed data pipelines using BigQuery and Dataflow to aggregate and transform raw customer data from multiple systems, ensuring high data quality and scalability.
Orchestrated the end-to-end ML workflows using Cloud Composer, coordinating data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and automated deployment within the GCP ecosystem.
Integrated RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LLMs on Vertex AI to support personalized FAQ responses and support ticket summarization, improving support response quality.
Implemented chunking, embedding generation, and semantic search using Vertex AI’s vector database to power retrieval systems for the RAG pipeline, improving context relevance and latency.
Created secure, production-grade model endpoints using Apigee to expose LLM and churn model APIs internally, allowing business units to integrate AI predictions into applications via proxy URLs.
Designed monitoring systems to track model performance, concept drift, and data anomalies using Vertex AI Model Monitoring and BigQuery dashboards, triggering retraining jobs when needed.
Ran A/B tests and uplift modeling to evaluate the impact of churn predictions and LLM-generated responses on user engagement, campaign conversion rates, and support deflection.
Delivered measurable business value with a 27% improvement in retention campaign effectiveness and faster customer support interactions, driving higher NPS and reduced churn.
Presented results and model insights to business leaders and product managers using interactive dashboards in Looker Studio, integrating predictive outputs into business KPIs.
Contributed to Verizon’s internal AI capability by mentoring junior team members on modern MLOps practices with GCP, sharing knowledge on LLM prompt engineering, and prototyping new applications using Vertex AI's generative AI tools.

Petronas– Data Scientist | Oil & Gas | Bangalore, India | Jul 2021 – Feb 2022
Designed predictive maintenance models for industrial equipment using ARIMA, Random Forest, Isolation Forest, and Deep Learning architectures (LSTM, Autoencoders) to identify early equipment failure patterns, reducing unplanned downtime for refinery clients by 10%. Incorporated sensor readings, maintenance logs, and operational metadata into model training.
Built automated data pipelines in Python and SQL within Azure Data Factory to ingest and transform IoT telemetry data from refinery operations. Ensured data quality through validation scripts and anomaly flagging.
Deployed machine learning models using Azure Machine Learning and integrated them into CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions and Jenkins, enabling rapid iteration and consistent version control.
Configured model monitoring in Azure to track drift, accuracy, and inference performance, ensuring reliability in production.
Utilized Azure Databricks for distributed data processing and feature engineering on large sensor datasets, accelerating model training and experiment cycles.
Leveraged Azure HDInsight clusters for big data storage and scalable analytics on historical machine logs, optimizing pipeline performance and data retrieval latency.
Deployed machine learning models using Azure Machine Learning and containerized inference services on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for scalable, production-grade deployment with built-in monitoring and auto-scaling.
Integrated model predictions into Power BI dashboards for operations teams, allowing real-time anomaly alerts and proactive maintenance scheduling.
Collaborated with engineers and field technicians to refine model features based on real-world feedback, improving predictive accuracy over multiple iterations.

Philips Healthcare– Data Analyst | Healthcare | Bangalore, India | Feb 2018 – Jul 2021
Developed automated Tableau dashboards to track key performance indicators for healthcare technology systems, enabling real-time visibility into system health. Reduced response times to critical incidents by 20% by implementing automated alerts and visual triggers.
Designed and implemented predictive maintenance models using Python and scikit-learn, leveraging historical usage data, error logs, and environmental factors. These models decreased equipment downtime by 15% and earned an Excellence Award for operational efficiency.
Built SQL-based data pipelines to aggregate, clean, and normalize data from multiple hospital and diagnostic systems. Ensured high data integrity for downstream analytics and predictive modeling.
Partnered with clinical engineering teams to identify patterns in device failures and optimize maintenance schedules. Integrated predictive insights into operational workflows to prevent unexpected service disruptions.
Worked closely with product managers and healthcare IT specialists to translate business problems into actionable data solutions. Delivered prototypes and proof-of-concepts for rapid stakeholder evaluation.
Optimized Tableau visualizations for executive and operational reporting by applying advanced calculations, parameter controls, and custom SQL queries. Improved report load times and usability for non-technical users.
Performed statistical analysis on patient care workflows to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies. Recommended process changes that improved patient throughput and reduced delays.
Applied clustering and classification techniques to categorize medical device issues based on severity and recurrence. Enabled proactive escalation for high-risk cases.
Developed Python automation scripts for repetitive data preparation and reporting tasks. Reduced manual reporting effort and error rates significantly.
Collaborated with database administrators to enhance query performance by indexing, partitioning, and optimizing joins. Achieved faster data retrieval for analytics and reporting needs.
Documented all dashboards, data pipelines, and models for long-term maintainability. Created knowledge transfer materials for handover to support teams.
